description: This file defines a PHP class 'CodeGuruReviewerClient' within the AWS SDK for interacting with the Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer service. It includes method annotations for various API calls and their asynchronous counterparts, serving as a client interface for the service.

classes.name: CodeGuruReviewerClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with Amazon CodeGuru Reviewer service via AWS SDK.

methods.name: associateRepository
methods.description: Associates a repository with the CodeGuru Reviewer service.

methods.name: describeCodeReview
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific code review.

methods.name: describeRepositoryAssociation
methods.description: Describes an association between a repository and the service.

methods.name: disassociateRepository
methods.description: Removes the association between a repository and the service.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.
